TCS Reports Slowest Q2 Growth in Three Years Amidst Muted Demand

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) reported its slowest second-quarter revenue growth in three years, with a 0.2% sequential increase in the July-September period. This growth, however, exceeded analyst expectations. The company noted momentum in Artificial Intelligence (AI) services but observed that overall deal flow remained muted.
